integrity: The full local-ring theorem is mathematically proved in RESULT.md. Computer checks are finite, and the literature comparison is not an independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Applies only over the complex numbers to quadratic Veronese varieties with exactly the mixed monomial \(x_0x_1\) omitted, and \(n\ge3\).
The projective surface case, homogeneous normalization, homogeneous Hilbert series and homogeneous Cohen-Macaulay classifications are previously published and are not claimed as new.
An inaccessible early paper by P. Schenzel on Veronese projections leaves a residual historical-equivalence risk.
Finite exact semigroup computations corroborate but cannot prove the all-dimension statement.
title: Local germs and the conductor of quadratic pinched Veronese varieties
